lines.en: label makigenafternoon:
I tap on Maki's name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点开 Maki 的名字，等她接起来。

lines.en: : Afternoon, Sensei! To what do I owe this pleasure?
lines.zh: : 下午好，Sensei！我这是哪来的这份荣幸？

lines.en: scene black
Maki and I make plans to meet up for coffee at Koi Cafe.
lines.zh: 我和 Maki 约好在 Koi Cafe 喝咖啡。

lines.en: She still has some time before she has to open the porn shop, so this is a good opportunity for the two of us to get closer...
lines.zh: 她离色情用品店开门还有一会儿，这正好是我俩拉近关系的好机会……

lines.en: scene makiafternoongen
We meet up roughly half an hour later and get to chatting over lunch and coffee.
lines.zh: 大约半小时后我们碰了面，边吃午饭边喝咖啡聊起来。

lines.en: I expected Maki to be a little different outside of work, but I'm quickly realizing that isn't the case.
lines.zh: 我本以为 Maki 下了班会有点不一样，但很快就发现根本不是这样。

lines.en: If anything, she might actually be even more vulgar in public.
lines.zh: 要说的话，她在公众场合可能还更下流一点。

lines.en: Apparently, Maki wasn't always the twisted pervert she is now and was actually closer to having Makoto's demeanor back in the day.
lines.zh: 原来 Maki 也不是一直都像现在这么扭曲变态，当年她的举止反而更接近 Makoto。

lines.en: She tells me a few stories of how she acted back in [high_school] and the difference is like night and day.
lines.zh: 她跟我讲了几个[高中]时的故事，那差别简直是天壤之别。

lines.en: But seeing what she's become now will never cease to amaze me when compared to how closed-off and high-strung her daughter is.
lines.zh: 但一想到她女儿有多封闭、多紧绷，再看看她如今变成的样子，我永远都会觉得不可思议。

lines.en: I wonder if there's any reason for that...
lines.zh: 不知道这中间是不是有什么原因……

lines.en: scene black
An hour or two passes by before the two of us decide to head out.
lines.zh: 过了一两个小时，我俩才决定走。

lines.en: It isn't until I'm walking through the city that I realize how strange it is to feel closer to someone even when fifty-percent of your conversations end in sex jokes.
lines.zh: 直到我走在城里，才意识到这有多奇怪——哪怕你一半的对话都以黄色笑话收尾，你还是会觉得跟某个人更近了。
